title: Chat socket v1: client frame
description: A frame the client sends on /ws/public/v1/chat/{slug}. Send at most one `auth`, then one `message` or `answer`; `cancel` stops the run.

auth.description: Who is chatting, before the message: an anonymous visitor token, or a user token signed by the app's backend (TASK-0218).

token.description: A user token (JWT) signed with an app key.

attachments.description: Ids of files uploaded to this chat first.

locale.description: `en` or `vi`: the language of system messages.

answer.description: The answer to the Human node question the run waits at.

node.description: The question's node, from the `question` frame.

response.description: Text, or an object for a form question.
